text:
Sidra Ahmed: hey everyone! excited to join Redwood Inference — Sidra here (SF, PST). I build tiny hardware synths, make bad bagels on weekends, and I usually work 9–5 PST. looking forward to meeting folks :) :wave:
Jordan Li: welcome Sidra!! do you accept bagel bribes? :bagel: where do you sit?
Sidra Ahmed: haha yes, bribes accepted. remote-first but in for office socials — 3rd floor near the big monstera when i'm in. favorite bagel = everything with extra sesame.
Priya Singh: welcome from London! we should sync on infra + latency stuff some time — morning your time is afternoon mine. also, synth nerd here too :synth:
Casey Morales: FYI there's a casual bagel run every Friday at 9:30am in the kitchen. you should join next week. i'll save you an everything if you promise to bring a mini synth demo someday :grin:
Lila Park: welcome! love that you make synths — maybe rooftop jam one day? also RE: onboarding — poke me if you can't find your laptop sleeve in kit pickup.
Tomáš Novák: Ahoj Sidra, welcome! If you're into midi stuff, i've got a small modular setup in bench 2. can show sometime after lunch.
Sidra Ahmed: omg yes to jam + modular. also heads-up i prefer async onboarding notes — will read them overnight before jumping into calls. thanks for the bagel intel :heart:
welcome-bot: Welcome Sidra Ahmed to #new-hires! You were added to the company directory and given access to the synths channel. :tada:
Jordan Li: also, where's best coffee order around the office? i recommend the espresso machine on floor 1 — shout if you want a tour.
Sidra Ahmed: perfect — i'll try to be a regular. thanks everyone!! excited to meet y'all in person and share some terrible homemade bagels :bagel: :sparkles:
